claim: Patchline publishes comparison pages against code scanning, SQL linters, migration tools, observability dashboards, and AI coding assistants. The pages are grounded in regenerated public-code evidence and explain when Patchline complements, differs from, or should defer to adjacent tools.

pages.title: Patchline vs code scanning
pages.adjacent_strength: Great at surfacing language-level vulnerabilities and publishing SARIF into review workflows.
pages.patchline_difference: Patchline specializes in data-change repair evidence: migration context, ranked data risks, bounded generated interventions, and compare artifacts.
pages.complementary_workflow: Upload Patchline SARIF beside code-scanning SARIF, then link high-risk data-change findings to the analysis bundle.

pages.title: Patchline vs SQL linters
pages.adjacent_strength: Great at style, dialect syntax, local anti-patterns, and fast SQL feedback.
pages.patchline_difference: Patchline links SQL-like changes to repository context, provenance, generated guards, risk budgets, and deterministic compare results.
pages.complementary_workflow: Run SQL linters before Patchline; use Patchline when a migration needs cross-file evidence and reviewable repair context.

pages.title: Patchline vs migration tools
pages.adjacent_strength: Great at applying, ordering, and rolling back framework-native migrations.
pages.patchline_difference: Patchline does not replace migration runners; it analyzes and packages evidence about risky data changes before humans approve them.
pages.complementary_workflow: Keep framework migration tools as the executor, and use Patchline to review blast radius, generated interventions, and proof holes.

pages.title: Patchline vs observability dashboards
pages.adjacent_strength: Great at showing production symptoms, deploy timelines, traces, logs, monitors, and SLO impact.
pages.patchline_difference: Patchline starts in code review and links repository-native findings to incident and telemetry exports without requiring proprietary APIs.
pages.complementary_workflow: Use dashboards to identify runtime impact, then use Patchline artifacts to connect the incident back to data-change evidence.

pages.title: Patchline vs AI coding assistants
pages.adjacent_strength: Great at interactive code generation, explanation, and broad programming assistance.
pages.patchline_difference: Patchline is deterministic by default: generated code remains quarantined review material until evidence and compare checks justify trust.
pages.complementary_workflow: Use assistants for drafting if desired, but route data-change repairs through Patchline's budgets, provenance, rejection examples, and bundle evidence.
